name: Stanley Black & Decker
outlook:
What Stanley Black & Decker says to expect

  • Full year 2026: EPSThe Company is raising 2026 GAAP EPS to be in the range of $5.45 to $5.85 , from a prior range of $4.60 to $5.45. The Company is also raising and tightening the adjusted EPS* range to $5.95 to $6.25 , from a prior range of $5.20 to $5.80.
  • Full year 2026: free cash flowFree cash flow* is now expected to be in the range of $1.0 billion to $1.2 billion , revised from $600 million to $800 million, which incorporates the tariff refund realized year-to-date and projected taxes and fees associated with the CAM divestiture.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed November 4, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
